entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: Non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standards.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: Industry consortium that creates open standards for 3D graphics, including glTF.

entities.name: INRIA
entities.note: French national research institute where 3D Gaussian Splatting was developed.

entities.name: Niantic
entities.note: Technology company that developed the SPZ format for compressing Gaussian splats.

entities.name: Luma AI
entities.note: Company specializing in neural radiance fields and AI-driven 3D generation.

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.note: AI research organization that developed Point-E, Shap-E, and ChatGPT.

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.note: AI research company that created the Claude models and the Model Context Protocol.

entities.name: PlayCanvas
entities.note: Organization behind the open-source WebGL game engine and SuperSplat tool.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The fourth major version of the Extensible 3D graphics standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.1
entities.note: Upcoming version of the X3D standard, introducing new nodes like GaussianSplats.

entities.name: glTF 2.0
entities.note: The GL Transmission Format for efficient delivery of 3D scenes and models.

entities.name: Model Context Protocol
entities.note: An open standard that enables AI models to securely interact with local tools and data sources.

entities.name: PLY
entities.note: Polygon File Format, widely used to store 3D point clouds and Gaussian splat data.

entities.name: SPZ
entities.note: A compressed file format for 3D Gaussian Splatting developed by Niantic.

entities.name: 3DGS
entities.note: The seminal 2023 paper '3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering'.

entities.name: KHR_gaussian_splatting
entities.note: A proposed glTF extension for embedding Gaussian splatting data within glTF assets.

entities.name: GaussianSplats
entities.note: A new X3D node proposed for X3D 4.1 to support rendering of 3D Gaussian splats.

entities.name: x3dom
entities.note: An open-source framework for integrating X3D into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A WebGL-based X3D player that supports modern X3D features including splats.

entities.name: PlayCanvas Engine
entities.note: A WebGL/WebGPU game engine that natively supports 3DGS rendering.

entities.name: SuperSplat
entities.note: An open-source tool by PlayCanvas for editing and optimizing 3D Gaussian splats.

entities.name: gsplat.js
entities.note: A JavaScript library for rendering Gaussian splats in the browser.

entities.name: Luma Genie
entities.note: A text-to-3D AI generation tool developed by Luma AI.

entities.name: Meshy
entities.note: An AI-powered 3D generation platform supporting text-to-3D and image-to-3D.

entities.name: Shap-E
entities.note: A conditional generative model for 3D assets by OpenAI.

entities.name: Point-E
entities.note: A system for generating 3D point clouds from complex prompts by OpenAI.

entities.name: Blender MCP
entities.note: An MCP server integration allowing AI agents to control Blender and manipulate 3D scenes.

entities.name: ChatGPT
entities.note: An LLM by OpenAI capable of generating code for 3D scenes.

entities.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
entities.note: An LLM by Anthropic with strong coding capabilities and native MCP support.

entities.name: X3D Python Scene Access Interface
entities.note: A Python package for creating and manipulating X3D scenes, often targeted by LLM code generation.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key leader in the Web3D Consortium and developer of the X3D Python SAI.

entities.name: George Drettakis
entities.note: A senior researcher at INRIA and co-author of the original 3DGS paper.

entities.name: Bernhard Kerbl
entities.note: A researcher and co-author of the original 3D Gaussian Splatting paper.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: A core developer of x3dom who implemented Gaussian splatting support.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: The primary developer of the X_ITE X3D player.

entities.name: Web3D 2024
entities.note: The 29th International Conference on 3D Web Technology.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH 2023
entities.note: The major computer graphics conference where 3DGS was officially presented.
